title: Event (start, stop)
description: An edge on a digital input that means something to the process. Not retained.

ts.description: UTC time of the event at the node, RFC 3339 with Z. Omitted while the node clock is not synchronised.

seq.description: Per-node message counter, +1 on every message published, restarts at 0 on boot.

boot.description: Random id drawn at power-up. A new value means counters and seq restarted.

value.description: 1 on the active edge, 0 on release.
